description:
Use this when an agent needs official Fed, ECB and Bank of Canada policy rates and the official Treasury par yield curve. kind="intuitive" (the default) is policy rates plus the 10Y headline; kind="stats" is the full curve, prior session and 10Y move (the legacy `rates` path is a deprecated alias of this, still priced at 25 sats); kind="pro" adds recent daily curve history; kind="signals" is the policy-rate comparison, curve shift and inversion state. Official-source speed, not a news wire. Informational only, not a buy, sell or hold, and not endorsed by any central bank. Example: get_rates_data(kind="intuitive"). Returns JSON in the `data` field with source attribution. Read-only; the only side effect is the payment you choose to make.
Kinds and prices:
- kind="intuitive": 10 sats or $0.01 USDC. Official-source publication speed, not a news wire. Informational only, not a buy, sell or hold, and not endorsed by the Fed, Treasury, ECB or Bank of Canada. Data BitScore for freshness and source agreement. Use this when an agent needs the latest official Fed, ECB and Bank of Canada policy rates and the Treasury 10Y headline.
- kind="stats": 50 sats or $0.05 USDC. Official-source publication speed, not a news wire. Informational only, not a buy, sell or hold, and not endorsed by the Fed, Treasury, ECB or Bank of Canada. Data BitScore for freshness and source agreement. Use this when an agent needs official policy rates plus the official Treasury par yield curve, the prior session and the 10Y move.
- kind="pro": 100 sats or $0.10 USDC. Official-source publication speed, not a news wire. Informational only, not a buy, sell or hold, and not endorsed by the Fed, Treasury, ECB or Bank of Canada. Data BitScore for freshness and source agreement. Use this when an agent needs the official rates snapshot plus recent daily Treasury par yield curves in one call. MCP: get_rates_data(kind="pro").
- kind="signals": 200 sats or $0.20 USDC. Official-source publication speed, not a news wire. Informational only, not a buy, sell or hold, and not endorsed by the Fed, Treasury, ECB or Bank of Canada. Data BitScore for freshness and source agreement.
- kind="official": 25 sats or $0.025 USDC. Official-source publication speed, not a news wire. Informational only, not a buy, sell or hold, and not endorsed by the Fed, Treasury, ECB or Bank of Canada. Data BitScore for freshness and source agreement. Deprecated listed alias of rates_stats at the original 25 sat / $0.025 price.
Payment: Pay by calling without a credential, paying the Lightning invoice or the USDC amount, then retrying with l402_credential='<macaroon>:<preimage>' or x402_payment. One payment buys one response. Or prepay at /api/v1/credits (Bearer btf_ token) or add ?bt_pass=1 for a 5-minute pass. Details: https://api.bittuitive.ai/pay. Informational only; not financial, investment, legal or tax advice; provided as-is, with no warranty; verify before acting. https://api.bittuitive.ai/disclaimer.

bank.description: Optional policy bank: fed, ecb or boc.

credit_token.description: Prepaid token (btf_..., from buy_credits). Pays this call from your prepaid sats or USDC balance with no invoice; a failed call is refunded. Balance is non-refundable.

kind.description: Product to fetch. Every kind, its price and when to use it are listed in the tool description.

l402_credential.description: L402 credential '<macaroon>:<preimage_hex>' from a paid invoice (or an active subscription). Omit it on the first call to receive the Lightning invoice and macaroon.

short_pass.description: If true, pay 5x the call price for a 5-minute pass (up to 20 calls to this same endpoint, any parameters). After paying, retry with the same credential or the X-Pass token.

x402_payment.description: x402 payment (USDC on Base): base64 PaymentPayload signed for accepts[0] of the payment_required result. Alternative to l402_credential; also accepted in params._meta['x402/payment'].
